DISPLAY="${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_churnmodelfd281c"
MODEL_ID=$(gcloud ai models list --region=$GCP_LOCATION --filter="displayName=$DISPLAY" --format="value(name)" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

gcloud ai models list-version "$MODEL_ID" --region=$GCP_LOCATION --format="table(versionId,displayName)" 2>/dev/null
echo "---DESCRIBE---"
gcloud ai models describe "$MODEL_ID" --region=$GCP_LOCATION --format="value(displayName,versionId,description,artifactUri)" 2>/dev/null
